title: Plant Forward environmental message
slide_intent: Give an ambition a clear verbal hierarchy so readers can distinguish the goal from its framing idea.
strategic_value: A dated carbon-neutrality ambition can make Sweetgreen’s environmental positioning concrete while remaining a historical claim.
demonstration: White text on a translucent panel over farmland reads Plant, Carbon Neutrality by 2027, and Forward.
practical_value: Separate a campaign’s stated future goal from evidence that the goal has been achieved.

content_islands.name: Landscape
content_islands.spec: Use the cultivated field and trees as the full photographic ground.

content_islands.name: Message panel
content_islands.spec: Place the stacked environmental statement on a tall translucent central panel.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork applies the identity to an environmental campaign statement.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large white type and a transparent vertical field leave the agricultural setting visible.
